reason: The README describes a DSH plugin that discovers local Agent Skills and related files, converts adjacent formats, injects them into DSH context and skill registries, and provides skill diagnostics.

summaries.zh: 将本地 Agent Skills、Cursor 规则和 Claude Code 命令转换并接入 DSH，同时提供技能发现与触发诊断功能。
summaries.en: Connects local Agent Skills and selected Cursor or Claude Code formats to DSH, with skill discovery and trigger diagnostics.

capabilities: discovers local skill and context files
reads and converts supported Markdown-based skill formats
injects skill metadata and project context into DSH
provides skill discovery and trigger-testing commands
